hooks.name: Spec documents may be out of sync
hooks.description: Fires when a spec's requirements.md changes, because design.md and tasks.md almost always need a matching edit. IDE and CLI only.

action.prompt: A spec's requirements.md just changed. Before moving on, check whether that spec's design.md and tasks.md still match it: a new or altered acceptance criterion usually needs a design decision and at least one task, and every task should still carry a _Requirements:_ reference that resolves. If the change touched the verdict or cause vocabulary, check .kiro/steering/product.md and the other four specs too, since that vocabulary is shared across all of them. Report what you changed or state plainly that nothing else needed changing.
